description: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
description_zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

name: dsh-workspace-search
author: tsonglew
description: VS Code-style workspace keyword search tab for dsh-better-sidebar: matches file names and content, grouped by file with line numbers, opens in the sidebar editor.
description_zh: VS Code 式工作区关键词搜索 Tab（better-sidebar 扩展）：同时匹配文件名与文件内容，结果按文件分组带行号，点击在侧栏编辑器打开。

name: dsh-media-preview
author: tsonglew
description: Audio/video FileViewer for dsh-better-sidebar: native inline playback for mp4/webm/mkv/mov and mp3/flac/wav, served by a Range-capable streaming media route.
description_zh: better-sidebar 音视频预览器：原生播放器内联播放 mp4/webm/mkv/mov 等视频与 mp3/flac/wav 等音频，自带支持 HTTP Range 拖动的流式媒体路由。

name: dsh-sticky-disclosure
author: Han-1413141
description: One-click collapse of every expanded section (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.
description_zh: 一键收起会话中所有展开的区块（Think、工具卡等），常驻计数按钮 + 自定义快捷键。

name: dsh-sticky-note
author: Meredith2328
description: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.
description_zh: 编辑框工具栏便签，随手记点子和 TODO，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话。

name: dsh-web-attention-badge
author: Luaphes
description: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
description_zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。

name: dsh-web-ui#packages/dsh-web-ui-all
author: zhu1090093659
description: Plugin and skin collection for the DSH Web UI: task board, Git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center.
description_zh: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务看板、git 图、右侧面板、远程移动端 UI、桌宠、实时 token 统计与皮肤中心。

name: dsh-pet
author: zealot00
description: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: sprite-sheet animation, agent state linkage, drag, alarm (daily/one-shot) and pomodoro widgets, skin picker with preview.
description_zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：精灵图动画、agent 状态联动、拖拽、闹钟（每天/一次）与番茄钟，皮肤下拉选择 + 预览。

name: dsh-desktop-pet
author: sereinmono
description: A plugin that adds a desktop pet to your DeepSeek Harness, supporting the Codex pet format, you can use hatch-pet or Petdex to add your pets.
description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物：完全支持 Codex 桌宠格式，可使用 hatch-pet Skill 创建宠物，或通过 Petdex 导入宠物。

name: dsh-ux
author: jiangnanquan
description: Solarized light theme, compact layout, think/tool-chain collapse capsules, and balance, session cost, and usage dashboards for the DSH web UI.
description_zh: Solarized 浅色主题、紧凑布局、思考/工具链折叠胶囊，以及余额、本轮成本与用量看板的 DSH Web 界面增强插件。

name: dsh-hud
author: a903067276-rgb
description: HUD status panel: Git status, MCP servers, skills, model and token usage in a floating side panel.
description_zh: HUD 状态面板：Git 状态、MCP 服务器、技能列表、模型与 token 用量，悬浮侧栏一览无余。

name: dsh-plugins#turn-scrubber
author: wsxwj123
description: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation.
description_zh: 右侧紧凑回合刻度条，悬停显示回合摘要，点击跳转到对应用户回合。

name: dsh-file-mentions
author: a903067276-rgb
description: Clickable file paths in DSH replies: Codex-style inline open, reveal in file manager, and a mentioned-files chip list at the turn tail.
description_zh: DSH 回复中的文件路径可点击：Codex 风格行内打开、文件管理器定位、回合尾部文件 chip 列表。

name: dsh-markdown-preview
author: GitHubJiKe
description: In-chat preview for produced files: click a produced-file chip to render Markdown (server-side markdown-it + highlight.js), images, or plain text right in the conversation; system-app open and reveal-
description_zh: 产物文件聊天内预览：点击产物 chip 直接在对话中渲染 Markdown（宿主侧 markdown-it + highlight.js 代码高亮）、图片或纯文本，系统应用打开与在文件夹中显示仍一键可达。

name: dsh-calculator
author: bobcat848
description: DeepSeek API spend (current session and all sessions) and account balance in the aside panel, with official pricing and peak/off-peak support.
description_zh: 右侧面板展示 DeepSeek API 费用（当前会话 + 全部会话累计）与账户余额，内置官方计价与峰谷计价支持。

name: dsh-deepseek-billing
author: Jolly-J
description: DeepSeek account balance and per-session cost card in the sidebar foot.
description_zh: 侧边栏底部 DeepSeek 账户余额显示与会话费用估算卡片。

name: dsh-auto-continue
author: HsiangNianian
description: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: sends a queued 「继续」 after network, timeout or host-crash failures, with error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text and browser notificat
description_zh: DSH Web 请求中断自动续跑：网络、超时或宿主崩溃等非人为失败后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、模板化继续文本与浏览器通知。

name: dsh-chat-outline
author: liliuCourier
description: Persistent left-hand conversation outline: questions and final replies per turn, keyword filter, one-click jump.
description_zh: 对话栏左侧常驻大纲：按轮次列出提问与最后回复，支持关键词过滤与一键跳转。

name: dsh-token-usage
author: LaoYueHanNi
description: Per-request model token usage tracked to per-day JSONL files, with a stats page in Web settings: daily trend chart, per-model breakdown, and date/model filters.
description_zh: 按请求持久化模型 token 用量，Web 设置「Token 用量」统计页：按日趋势图、按模型明细表、日期/模型筛选。

name: dsh-mic-input
author: QT-Chen
description: Microphone voice input for the composer: browser Web Speech API live transcription, dedupe/auto-continue, smart punctuation, language and auto-send settings.
description_zh: 输入框麦克风语音输入：浏览器 Web Speech API 实时转写，自动去重/续听、智能标点，支持语言与自动发送设置。

name: dsh-task-dag
author: LeemanCheung
description: Displays a Session's subagents and durable workflow runs as a live DAG with status, navigation, and restart-safe history.
description_zh: 将会话子代理与持久工作流运行展示为实时 DAG，支持状态展示、节点导航与重启后历史恢复。

name: widget-dock
author: MorGogh
description: Draggable workbench of mini-cards (API balance, token usage, session stats, goal, cost) on the blank areas beside the conversation, with size tiers and official DeepSeek pricing.
description_zh: 对话两侧空白区的可拖动卡片工作台：余额、Token 用量、会话统计、目标、成本估算等小组件，支持 S/M/L/XL 尺寸档位与官方定价成本估算。

name: dsh-reasoning-slider
author: qjcnmd
description: Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.
description_zh: Codex 风格推理等级滑块，内嵌于模型选择器，拖动切换推理档位。

name: dsh-sampling-sliders
author: Semidia
description: Model sampling sliders (temperature / maxTokens) in the composer: override every model request for all providers via the agent/request hook, with hot/persist modes.
description_zh: 对话输入区的模型采样滑杆（temperature / maxTokens）：通过 agent/request 钩子对所有供应商的每次请求生效，支持热调/持久化两种模式。

name: dsh-pomodoro
author: causebefore
description: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.
description_zh: DSH Web 番茄钟：提供可配置专注/休息循环、可拖动迷你面板，以及站内提醒、提示音和浏览器通知。

name: dsh-plugin-terminal
author: siberiah2o
description: Bottom multi-tab terminal panel (node-pty + xterm.js) pinned to the viewport bottom, always below the input box.
description_zh: 底部多标签终端面板（node-pty + xterm.js）：贴底全宽，输入框始终在终端上方。

name: dsh-outline
author: urzeye
description: Real-time outline panel for the DSH Web session page: user questions plus a Markdown heading tree (H1–H6) that updates live during streaming, with click-to-locate highlighting, expand-depth control, s
description_zh: DSH Web 会话页实时大纲面板：「用户问题 + Markdown 标题（1~6 级）」大纲树，流式生成时实时更新，点击节点滚动定位并高亮，支持展开深度调节、搜索与会话级收藏。

name: dsh-heatmap
author: 283Gawin
description: Activity heatmap in the DSH Web sidebar: GitHub-style grid of daily commits, token usage, and estimated spend, with a today stats line for all-session token totals, cache hit rate, and per-model auto-
description_zh: DSH Web 侧边栏活动热力图：GitHub 风格网格展示每日提交、Token 用量与估算花费，今日统计行显示全会话 Token 总量、缓存命中率与按模型自动计价的花费。

name: dsh-usage-chart
author: Max-Samson
description: Token, cost, and balance dashboard under the composer: live indicator plus zero-dependency SVG charts for per-turn usage, estimated cost, and DeepSeek account balance.
description_zh: 输入框下方的用量/成本/余额仪表盘：实时指标指示器 + 零依赖 SVG 用量图表，按轮次统计用量、估算成本并实时查询 DeepSeek 账户余额。

name: dsh-desktop-windowos#plugin
author: RAFOLIE
description: Windows tray desktop shell for DSH: auto-installs the exe from GitHub Releases, creates a desktop shortcut, and adds a desktop_launch tool to start it from chat.
description_zh: DSH 的 Windows 托盘桌面壳：自动从 GitHub Releases 安装 exe、创建桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

name: dsh-window#plugin
author: ZichengGurrr
description: Native Windows desktop window (WebView2) for DSH: one-command install, auto-fetches the app zip from GitHub Releases, creates a desktop shortcut, and adds a desktop_launch tool to start it from chat.
description_zh: DSH 的 Windows 原生窗口（WebView2）：一键安装，自动从 GitHub Releases 下载应用 zip、创建桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

name: dsh-window#kit
author: ZichengGurrr
description: All-in-one bundle for DSH: the native Windows desktop window (WebView2), DeepEye vision (GLM-4V-Flash), and voice input (mic button) in a single install.
description_zh: DSH 三件套全家桶：Windows 原生窗口（WebView2）+ DeepEye 视觉（GLM-4V-Flash）+ 语音输入（麦克风按钮），一条命令装齐。

name: dsh-web-preview
author: zoumutou
description: Side web-preview panel: local static hosting, Markdown/code/image preview, one-click run of non-static projects (Cargo/npm/Go/Python) with live logs, web element mark & annotate, and link-click takeov
description_zh: 侧边网页预览面板：本地静态托管、Markdown/代码/图片预览、非静态项目一键运行（Cargo/npm/Go/Python）实时日志、网页元素标记批注、链接点击接管到侧边预览。

name: dsh-plugin-llm-balance
author: FengHuoLinShan
description: Draggable floating card showing the balance/quota of your most recently used providers (DeepSeek/Moonshot/Kimi For Coding): auto-discovery, color-coded tiers, live refresh.
description_zh: 可拖动的 API 余额/配额悬浮卡片：自动显示最近使用的 provider 余额/配额（DeepSeek/Moonshot/Kimi For Coding），按余额分档变色、实时刷新。

name: dsh-balance-float
author: x2802490130-prog
description: A floating balance widget for the Web UI: live DeepSeek account balance with manual refresh and a Y/N-confirmed graceful exit.
description_zh: Web UI 右上角悬浮窗：实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，支持手动刷新与一键优雅退出（Y/N 快捷键确认）。

name: dsh-session-manager
author: Semidia
description: Right-click session menu and sidebar session manager: pin, rename, archive, fork, export, copy cwd/id/deep link, and open in explorer or a new window.
description_zh: 会话行右键菜单与侧边栏会话管理：置顶、重命名、归档、分叉、导出、复制工作目录/会话 ID/深链，在资源管理器或新窗口打开。

name: dsh-lan-pass
author: x2802490130-prog
description: A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.
description_zh: Web UI 局域网密码门禁：同网手机/平板输共享密钥登录，会话与电脑实时同步，内置 randomUUID polyfill。

name: dsh-turn-marks
author: magicOF2
description: Left-edge turn-marks strip in chat: one bar per user message, click to jump to that message, hover for a preview, active bar turns white.
description_zh: 会话左侧消息标记条：每发一条消息多一根条条，点击跳转到该消息、悬停预览内容，当前消息对应的条条变白。

name: dsh-chat-width-customizer
author: magicOF2
description: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.
description_zh: 会话标题栏按钮循环切换对话宽度（748–1600px），消息区、输入框、用户气泡同步加宽。

name: dsh-plugins#plugins/dsh-balance-plugin
author: luokai-demo
description: DeepSeek wallet balance at the sidebar foot: a credit-card icon with the amount tinted by remaining balance (green over ¥2, amber ¥0–2, red below), refreshed on mount, per turn-end, and on click; a si
description_zh: 侧边栏底部的 DeepSeek 钱包余额：信用卡图标配余额数字，按剩余额度着色（≥ ¥2 绿色、¥0–2 黄色、≤ ¥0 红色），挂载时、每轮对话结束和点击时刷新；余额变动时带符号差额上飘淡出。

name: dsh-plugins#dsh-plugin-setting-mcp
author: Ceelog
description: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
description_zh: 在 Web 设置面板中查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用或停用 MCP 服务器，保存后热重载。

name: dsh-opencodego-usage
author: BeiZi6
description: OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI: a breathing indicator at the input's bottom-right (green/yellow/red by remaining share), a liquid-glass panel with rolling/weekly/monthly usage windows an
description_zh: OpenCodeGo 剩余额度监视器：输入框右下角呼吸指示灯（按剩余额度绿/黄/红），液态玻璃面板显示滚动/周/月用量窗口与重置时间，每 30 秒自动刷新，API Key 自动读取 DSH 凭据。

name: terminal
author: giiiiiithub
description: Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js; multi-tab sessions, dock/floating window, clipboa
description_zh: DSH Web UI 终端面板：宿主端 node-pty 真实 PTY（Windows 默认 cmd.exe）+ 浏览器 xterm.js 渲染；多标签会话、停靠/浮动窗口、复制粘贴。

name: dsh-smooth-stream
author: SpookySandwich
description: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
description_zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

name: dsh-mobile-css
author: ook826092-cloud
description: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: compact typography, full-width composer with caret fix, drawer sidebar with overlay-close, two-page settings flow, responsive tables and stats, safe touch targets
description_zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：紧凑排版、全宽输入卡（含光标修复）、抽屉式侧边栏（点击遮罩关闭）、两页式设置流程、响应式表格与统计、安全触控目标。

name: dsh-git-status
author: Wongzexu
description: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branc
description_zh: 专精于 Git 分支与状态处理：Web 右缘 Git 状态浮窗，commit DAG 泳道图、未提交改动与 stash、行内 diff，右键分支/tag 切换、合并、重命名、删除、新建，一键拉取全部远程。

name: dsh-workspace-files-explorer
author: YZz-S
description: Floating workspace file-tree browser for the Web GUI with line-numbered syntax highlighting and Markdown preview.
description_zh: 悬浮工作区文件树浏览器：带行号的代码语法高亮与 Markdown 富文本预览。

name: dsh-token-cost-meter
author: YZz-S
description: Real-time session token usage and estimated cost in the composer stats row, with pricing fetched from DeepSeek official pricing page.
description_zh: 在输入框下方统计行实时显示当前会话累计 token 消耗与估算费用（人民币），价格从 DeepSeek 官方价格页动态获取。

name: dsh-pathlink
author: penguin-oo
description: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
description_zh: 在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

name: dsh-mermaid
author: AKS1st
description: Render Mermaid code fences in DSH Web chat messages as lazy-loaded SVG diagrams with strict sanitization and light/dark theme follow.
description_zh: 把 DSH Web 会话消息中的 Mermaid 代码围栏渲染为惰性加载的 SVG 图表，严格消毒并跟随明暗主题。

name: dsh-model-picker
author: Sanqi-normal
description: Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.
description_zh: dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

name: dsh-sysmon
author: AKS1st
description: System status floating widget: live CPU/memory/disk usage in the bottom-right corner of the DSH Web UI with threshold colour warnings.
description_zh: DSH Web 右下角系统状态悬浮窗：实时显示 CPU、内存、磁盘占用率，带阈值变色告警。

name: model-usage-plugin
author: AKS1st
description: Per-model token usage and cost estimation with DeepSeek account balance, shown in a Settings panel tab.
description_zh: 按模型统计 token 消耗并估算费用，同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，展示于设置面板「模型消耗」页签。

name: dsh-composer-history
author: PerryLink
description: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrow-key recall with exact draft and caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context awareness
description_zh: Web 作曲器终端风格输入历史：边缘优先的方向键召回并精确还原草稿与光标、浏览器本地持久化历史、Ctrl+R 反向搜索，以及滑动上下文感知（压缩摘要加入召回与搜索）。

name: dsh-toolfold
author: Minecraftbe
description: Codex-style tool call folding, collapsing multiple tool calls into a single line.
description_zh: Codex 风格的工具调用折叠，将多个工具调用折叠到一行内。

name: dsh-dream-skin
author: RevolutionLA
description: One-command skin plugin: 8 original themes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur, per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export, favorites and surprise-me — purely native on DSH's token s
description_zh: 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊）、强调色、主题包导入/导出+分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统接入。

name: dsh-skin
author: KinGao294
description: Codex-style skin switcher plus a custom wallpaper layer with opacity and blur controls.
description_zh: Codex 风格皮肤切换器 + 自定义壁纸层，可调透明度与模糊。

name: dsh-deep-whale
author: Small-tailqwq
description: Whale-girl skin series for the DSH Web UI (maid-atelier).
description_zh: DSH Web 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier）。

name: dsh-plugins#theme-gallery
author: wsxwj123
description: Fifteen curated theme families with complete light and dark palettes that follow the native Light, Dark, and Follow system modes.
description_zh: 15 个精选主题家族，浅深配色完整，跟随 DSH 原生浅色/深色/跟随系统模式。

name: dsh-client-ui-skin-claude
author: PAKIKNOWLEDGE
description: Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, clay accent, and serif UI that follows the native light and dark themes.
description_zh: Claude 风格皮肤：暖黑画布、陶橙点缀、衬线 UI，跟随原生亮/暗主题。

name: dsh-font
author: tianyhjg-lab
description: Font switcher for the DSH Web GUI: 99 UI fonts and 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing stacks, instant apply and localStorage persistence.
description_zh: DSH Web GUI 字体切换器：99 个界面字体与 31 个代码字体，中西文自动搭配，即选即生效，localStorage 持久化。

name: dsh-blue-whale
author: starslittle
description: A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
description_zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

name: dsh-wallpaper
author: chinaRXQ
description: Wallpaper skin for the DSH Web UI: image background with opacity, mask and blur controls.
description_zh: DSH Web 壁纸皮肤：图片背景，可调透明度、压暗遮罩与模糊。

author: Tkingxiao

name: Catppuccin-dsh-theme

description_zh: DSH Web 液态玻璃皮肤：冰原/深水壁纸、可导入、壁纸透明度，以及叠在官方浅色/深色/跟随系统上的分岛模糊。

name: dsh-client-ui-skins

description_zh: DSH Web 换肤插件：4 套内置皮肤 + 自定义图片皮肤，图片作为全界面背景，配色自动跟随图片主色调。

name: dsh-cyber-particle
author: AKS1st
description: Particle-network background overlay for the DSH Web shell: full-screen, click-through, zero runtime dependencies.
description_zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供粒子网络动态背景：全屏覆盖、点击穿透、零运行时依赖。

name: dsh-qq2007-skin
author: LeemanCheung
description: QQ 2007-inspired retro skin for the DSH Web GUI, with native theme tokens, scoped three-pane chrome, an original pixel buddy, and a reversible Settings switch.
description_zh: DSH Web GUI 的 QQ 2007 风格复古皮肤：原生主题 token、三栏窗框、原创像素伙伴及可在设置中恢复的开关。

name: dsh-commandcode-provider
author: Mars-Sea
description: Unofficial Command Code LLM provider: registers a `commandcode` route with a live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.
description_zh: 非官方 Command Code 模型接入插件：注册 `commandcode` 路由，带实时模型目录与推理强度支持。

name: dsh-github-login
author: Noob-stupid
description: Visual GitHub login without a terminal: in-window device flow, token synced into the gh CLI, and host status/launch endpoints.
description_zh: 零终端的 GitHub 可视化登录插件：窗口内完成设备码授权，令牌同步进 gh CLI，附宿主端状态与唤起接口。

name: llm-adaptive
author: dylan121322
description: Adaptive model routing: per-request complexity classification with automatic provider routing.
description_zh: 自适应模型路由：请求级复杂度分类，按配置链自动选择后端 provider。

name: dsh-llm-fallbacks
author: btspoony
description: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategies.
description_zh: 基于角色的模型重试与备用策略。

name: dsh-codex-connect
author: franksong2702
description: Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.
description_zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 将 OpenAI Codex 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供可选的搜索与图片工具。

name: dsh-everything-oauth
author: kam74515-boop
description: Import local Codex, Grok, Claude, OpenCode, and CC Switch logins into DSH; pick sources and enable models in Settings.
description_zh: 把本机 Codex / Grok / Claude / OpenCode / CC Switch 登录态导入 DSH，在设置里自选来源并启用模型。

name: Qwen-MM-Plugins
author: omdsh-dev
description: Qwen multi-modal plugin support.
description_zh: Qwen 多模态插件支持。

name: dsh-codex-auth
author: suntianc
description: Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login as an `openai-codex` LLM route and adds GPT Auth controls to DSH Web settings.
description_zh: 复用 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录态注册 `openai-codex` LLM 路由，并在 DSH Web 设置中提供 GPT Auth 控件。

name: deepseek-harness-wallet
author: feibi-mochi
description: Multi-provider wallet chip: official DeepSeek balance, per-session cost & tokens, third-party token totals, recharge shortcut, low-balance alerts.
description_zh: 多供应商钱包标签：官方 DeepSeek 余额、本会话花费与 token、第三方合计 token、一键充值、低余额提醒。

name: dsh-model-router
author: superboy911
description: Deterministic keyword routing, allowlisted model switching, and an isolated image_gen channel for DeepSeek Harness.
description_zh: DSH 关键词路由与隔离生图插件：确定性关键词路由、白名单模型切换与隔离的 image_gen 生图通道。

name: dsh-vision-recognizer
author: kaixinbaba
description: Vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text through a configurable model (15+ OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic vendors) while DeepSeek keeps answering.
description_zh: 视觉模型路由：把附加图片经可配置模型（15+ OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 供应商）转译为文字，对话仍由 DeepSeek 作答。

name: keyringseam
author: fieldnote-ops
description: macOS Keychain credential provider that replaces the local-file provider and uses a signed, notarized universal helper.
description_zh: macOS Keychain 凭据提供器：替换本地文件提供器，并使用已签名、公证的通用二进制辅助程序。

name: dsh-billing-balance
author: YZz-S
description: Shows DeepSeek API account balance and Volcengine Ark Coding/Agent Plan quota windows (5h/weekly/monthly with reset countdowns) in the settings panel, composer dock, and a draggable floating refresh b
description_zh: 在设置页、输入框下方读数条与可拖动悬浮按钮三处显示 DeepSeek 官方 API 余额与火山方舟 Coding/Agent Plan 套餐额度（5小时/周/月窗口及重置倒计时）。

name: dsh-visual-plugin
author: jyh20030112
description: Gives text-only models vision: forwards user images to an OpenAI-compatible vision model and shows the descriptions in a Web UI right panel.
description_zh: 给纯文本模型装上眼睛：把用户图片转发给任意 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型生成描述，并在 Web UI 右侧面板展示结果。

name: dsh-model-sync
author: jiay98528-dev
description: Syncs live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d quota rings for the current session model.
description_zh: 把各提供方线上模型列表同步进 DSH 设置，并在输入框旁显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天额度圆环。

name: dsh-incognito
author: HuiHuitie-zhu
description: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.
description_zh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。

name: dsh-queue-plus
author: starslittle
description: Stock queue plus edit, remove, steer, reorder, clear-all, and 10-second undo.
description_zh: 出厂排队消息的增强面板：编辑、删除、插话，再加上排序、清空和 10 秒撤销。

name: dsh-solo-thinking
author: fredalxin
description: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sideba
description_zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

name: dsh-agent-team-room
author: ishuowang
description: Persistent rooms for independent DSH Agent sessions, with explicit membership, direct and broadcast messages, tracked tasks, and a shared Web timeline.
description_zh: 面向独立 DSH Agent 会话的持久化协作房间，支持显式成员管理、定向与广播消息、任务跟踪和共享 Web 时间线。

name: dsh-webchatlike
author: cindyguyuehu123
description: Bring the deepseek.com web/app chat experience to DSH: edit your prompt and regenerate answers in place, with a per-message <i/N> version pager (tree model, stable across conversations).
description_zh: 更贴近 deepseek 网页版/App 的聊天体验：原位编辑提问、重新生成回复、每条消息带 <i/N> 版本翻页器（树状版本模型，跨对话保持稳定）。

name: dsh-bookmarks
author: penguin-oo
description: Bookmark assistant replies with notes and tags; browse every bookmark in one cross-session center and export to Markdown.
description_zh: 收藏 AI 回复（备注/标签），跨会话收藏中心（搜索/筛选/跳回会话），一键导出 Markdown。

name: dsh-agent-message
author: GengDaPeng
description: Cross-session agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness with session discovery, offline delivery, delivery receipts, and sender-session navigation.
description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话 Agent 通信：支持会话发现、离线投递、投递回执与发送方会话导航。

name: dsh-crosstalk
author: Jesse-njx
description: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.
description_zh: 跨会话消息：本机任意会话都可像 Claude Code 一样列出并互发消息，基于本地心跳注册表与收件箱。

name: task-passport
author: dongsheng123132
description: Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.
description_zh: 通过机器可读检查点与乐观锁，在 DeepSeek Harness、WorkBuddy、Claude Code 和 Codex 之间交接持久任务状态。

name: dsh-task-relay
author: LeslieWylie
description: Cross-session task queue with handoff notes: sessions and subagents push, claim, complete and cancel tasks on a shared file-backed queue, and leave a handoff summary for whoever picks up next.
description_zh: 跨会话任务队列与交接摘要：会话与子 agent 在共享的文件队列上投递、认领、完成、取消任务，并留下交接摘要供后续会话查看。

name: dsh-share
author: hellodigua
description: Share your conversations with one click.
description_zh: 一键分享你的对话。

name: dsh-local-share
author: ChuanTianML
description: Export a complete Web Session to local Markdown or a self-contained HTML file, with preview-first redaction and opt-in bounded tool-call details.
description_zh: 把完整 Web Session 导出为本地 Markdown 或自包含 HTML 文件，提供导出前预览、默认脱敏和可选的有界工具调用详情。

name: dsh-message-edit
author: Moeblack
description: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.
description_zh: 基于分支的消息编辑、reroll、重试与版本时间线。

name: dsh-sidechain
author: Buyi-wsgzg
description: `/side` persistent side sessions and `/btw` one-shot side questions, run in a temporary fork without touching main history.
description_zh: `/side` 持续性侧会话与 `/btw` 一次性侧问，在临时 fork 中运行、不写入主会话历史。

name: dsh-conversation-share
author: bill9109
description: Share any excerpt of a conversation.
description_zh: 分享任意段落的对话。

name: dsh-explain
author: yuezengwu
description: Local-first learning mode: cross-session learning threads with per-source explanations.
description_zh: 本地优先学习模式：跨会话全局学习线程、按来源讲解。

name: dsh-prompt-studio
author: Moeblack
description: Edit user and built-in system-prompt sections with live preview.
description_zh: 带实时预览的用户/内置 system prompt 分节编辑器。

name: dsh-peer-link
author: czm15053
description: Let dsh and Claude Code sessions message each other directly; comes with a clickable peer list card (sort/search/send/refresh).
description_zh: 让 dsh 和 Claude Code 会话直接互发消息，附带可点击的会话列表卡片（搜索/刷新/弹窗发送）。

name: dsh-session-link
author: PwnKY
description: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
description_zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

name: dsh-chat-import
author: Nwflower
description: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude C
description_zh: 把 13 家 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini、opencode 等）的完整对话历史导入为可续聊的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持反向导出回 Claude Code。

name: dsh-file-claim
author: Nwflower
description: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
description_zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

name: dsh-interconnect
author: Chinesezjc
description: Cross-instance message and event handoff between DSH instances via an interconnect server.
description_zh: 跨实例互联：经 interconnect 服务在多个 DSH 实例间转发消息与事件。

name: dsh-inline-images
description: Render local image paths from assistant replies inline in the message body (9 formats, click-to-zoom lightbox, adjustable size).
description_zh: 对话内联图片：LLM 回复中输出的本地图片路径在消息正文直接渲染为图片（9 种格式、点击放大灯箱、可调尺寸）。

name: dsh-prompt-stash
author: Wine-Red
description: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.
description_zh: 本地、按会话隔离的 LIFO 输入暂存：临时收起未完成的输入，之后安全恢复并继续编辑。

name: dsh-side-chat
author: heartmove
description: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description_zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

name: dsh-session-export
author: bwndlct
description: Export the current session to portable, schema-versioned Markdown and JSON files via the `session_export` tool and slash commands, with cross-platform-safe filenames.
description_zh: 把当前会话导出为可移植、带 schema 版本的 Markdown 与 JSON 文件，提供 `session_export` 工具与斜杠命令两种入口，文件名跨平台安全。

name: dsh-suite#plugin-session-export
author: whyihaveyou
description: Export the append-only session log as human-readable Markdown or HTML, grouped by trajectory source.
description_zh: 把 append-only 会话日志导出为按轨迹来源分组的可读 Markdown 或 HTML。

name: dsh-session-search-pro
author: LeslieWylie
description: Search, list and read past and current sessions through the harness's own `sessionQuery` service: uses the SQLite FTS5 index where a deployment enables it, and falls back to a bounded newest-first sca
description_zh: 通过 harness 自带的 `sessionQuery` 服务搜索、列出、读取历史与当前会话：部署启用了 SQLite FTS5 索引时走索引，未启用时回退到有上限的倒序扫描。

name: dsh-plugin-session-delete
author: lsz-asd
description: Delete DSH sessions from the web UI and desktop client: header danger button and session-row menu item with a risk-consent dialog; host endpoint and agent tool remove the session log, projection cache
description_zh: 在 Web UI 与桌面客户端中删除 DSH 会话：头部危险按钮 + 会话行菜单项，风险确认弹窗，宿主端点与 agent 工具同步清理会话日志、投影缓存与工作区记账。

name: dsh-plugin-session-import
author: huguangyu666
description: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.
description_zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

name: dsh-companion
author: beijingwahw
description: Four-module session companion: smart conversation export (Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG long-image with privacy redaction and batch ZIP), context handoff summaries with template save/import, API cost optimiza
description_zh: 四模块会话伴侣：对话智能导出（Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG 长图、隐私脱敏、批量 ZIP）、上下文交接摘要（模板保存与导入继承）、API 成本优化（官方动态计价、峰谷调度、日/月双档预算、模型路由）、全局对话检索与对话内搜索（Ctrl+F、CSS Custom Highlight API）。

name: dsh-sideband
author: ishuowang
description: Asynchronous, LLM-summarized context relay between DSH Sessions and authorized Agent Team Rooms, with instant snapshots and scheduled digests.
description_zh: 在 DSH Session 与已授权 Agent Team Room 之间异步传递 LLM 总结的上下文，支持即时快照与定时摘要。

name: dsh-session-doctor
author: mayf3
description: Diagnose, unstick, and read DSH sessions: list sessions with agent status, read conversations, diagnose stuck agents, recover them with cancel+keepInbox, and send messages to other sessions.
description_zh: 会话医生：列出会话（含 agent 运行状态）、读取会话记录、诊断卡死的 agent、解卡（cancel + keepInbox 保留排队消息）、向其他会话发送消息。

name: dsh-archived-sessions
author: MuWinds
description: Archived-session management: browse archived sessions, unarchive them, or clear them out.
description_zh: 归档会话管理：浏览已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）与清空。

name: dsh-assistant-message-forge
author: anweat
description: Create/modify/inject test assistant messages and import/repair session.jsonl(.zstd) session logs into new sessions.
description_zh: 消息锻造台：创建/修改/注入测试用 assistant 消息，导入识别并安全修复 session.jsonl(.zstd) 会话日志为新会话。

name: dsh-session-report
author: yangyongzhen
description: Per-session cost & usage report cards: tokens, cache hits, duration.
description_zh: 会话成本与耗时报表：tokens / 缓存命中 / 耗时。

name: dsh-enter-customizer
author: Boliban
description: Take over the system input shortcuts for the chat input box and configure behavior independently for each shortcut.
description_zh: 接管聊天输入框的回车等快捷键，每个快捷键的行为都能单独配置。

name: dsh-plugins#dsh-session-manager
author: wsxwj123
description: Delete sessions with a 5-second undo and a recycle bin, plus an archive view to browse and unarchive, for the DSH Web GUI.
description_zh: 会话删除（5 秒可撤销 + 回收站）与归档视图（查看、取消归档）。

name: dsh-session-move
author: reinocheong
description: Move a session to another folder from the Web UI via drag & drop or a menu picker, permanently delete a session with a risk-consent dialog, and AI-rename a session by summarizing the whole conversatio
description_zh: 在 Web 侧边栏把会话移动到别的文件夹（拖拽或菜单选择），带风险确认地永久删除会话，以及 AI 重命名会话（总结整个对话并自动纠正错别字）；每个操作都提供 agent 工具。

name: distill
author: LoserFox

description_zh: 自动对话蒸馏：后台 subagent 反省 + 技能 create/update。

name: dsh-mnemon
author: omdsh-dev
description: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project doc

name: dsh-mneme#dsh-mneme

name: dsh-updater-ui
author: xingyingyuzhui

author: PerryLink

author: vlln

name: dsh-user-experience

name: dsh-cost-tracker

name: dsh-doctor#plugin

name: dsh-git-hygiene
author: lucky8197
description: Git hygiene checker: read-only scan of merged and stale branches, oversized tracked files, untracked files and uncommitted work, with cleanup suggestions (it never deletes anything).
